verdict.rationale: 1Password documents storing one-time passwords and offers apps on several devices: iOS/iPadOS, Apple Watch, desktop and browser. A user also reports that its desktop and mobile apps all work. However, no evidence item explicitly states that tokens sync automatically across phone, tablet and computer at the same time, so cross-device availability is only implied. Missing for 10: explicit first-party documentation of automatic multi-device sync of OTP tokens, confirmation of simultaneous availability on phone, tablet and computer, and independent hands-on corroboration of sync behavior.

support.subject: As an everyday user, my tokens are available on my phone, tablet, and computer at the same time, kept in sync automatically

citations.quote: Learn how to use 1Password to store and quickly access your one-time passwords when you turn on two-step verification for a website.
